raw_task_text: Prepare an evidence-grounded executive brief for an audit committee comparing two proposed operational changes. Preserve material uncertainty, do not invent unsupported facts, make the decision-relevant tradeoffs explicit, and keep claims within the supplied evidence.
objective: Produce a decision-useful evidence-grounded executive brief comparing the two proposed operational changes.
target_construct: Decision-useful professional quality under explicit evidence and uncertainty constraints
claim_scope: Only claims and comparisons supportable from the declared supplied evidence
